note: Approved: merge it, or fix what blocks it.
A human approval went stale after a push: re-request review.
The ticket is in an active sprint.
Every linked ticket is done but the PR never merged: close it if superseded.
No ticket, and no update or human review for 180 days: close it if abandoned.
Ready for review but not updated for 30 days: ping a reviewer, or convert it to a draft.
Updated in the last 30 days, but the ticket is still to do: move the ticket.
Not updated for 30 days and nothing to decide: close it when the work is dropped.
